techniques.name: Highlight-locked smash cut
techniques.description: N pages, each scaled and translated so that the highlighted phrase hits one target box. 2-4 frames each.
techniques.routeReason: Position must be exact to the pixel and repeatable, so pages should be our own React or screenshots with known phrase boxes. Page text must be truthful or visibly illustrative.

evidence: visuals/a1/b3-page-cuts.jpg page changes at F63, F67, F69, F72, F75, F78, F82, F84; F87 next shot

sound.note: Waveform is quiet and even through 2.1-2.9 s; no onset pattern establishes a hit per page. Not heard.

typography.entry: already on at each cut; the page is scaled so the highlight stays at one screen point

techniques.name: One column widens into a wall of real people
techniques.description: Column scrolls; neighbours appear as soft white blocks resolving into clips, outward from the centre; pull back to about 16 columns. Depends on dozens of real clips.
techniques.routeReason: The scene's meaning is that these are real people. Faces cannot be generated and presented as proof, and we need consented clips. The layout itself is Remotion, but the cost is the material. Decoding about 100 videos needs low-resolution proxies.

techniques.name: Centred sentence with cooling words and a travelling pill
techniques.description: Line recentres as each word arrives; colour from yellow to white in 9 frames; pill opens empty, fills, then snaps to a chosen word group; source line types itself; words delete in groups while the rest hold position.
techniques.routeReason: Text driven from data with exact timing. Measuring word widths gives both the recentring as words arrive and stable positions as they delete.

techniques.name: Big words pass a lens, small words wait
techniques.description: Horizontal track, words on one layer; focus depends on distance from frame centre; soft colour bloom and slight chromatic edge.
techniques.routeReason: Camera and DepthLayer give a focus falloff, but it is per layer: per-word blur from screen position needs a small addition. Bloom via CSS filter should be tested for banding: use grain.
